limitations: Historical tournament sample, not current MLS scouting data, a transfer forecast, or a recommendation to sign a player.
Similarity describes measured style, not quality, replacement success, tactical fit, or player valuation. Team/opponent context remains a confounder.
Successful-move xT does not fully debit failed moves, value defensive work, or measure total player contribution. Values depend on grid resolution and sparse cells.
Per-90 rates use event-derived minutes including stoppage time. Low-minute profiles remain unstable despite shrinkage; match bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not future-performance guarantees.
xT uses 48 chronological group-stage matches for fitting and 16 knockout matches for diagnostics. This tournament-stage shift is a limitation, not a randomized experiment.

Pitch control is a simplified, uncalibrated two-dimensional arrival model. It is not a complete pass-success model or a substitute for video review; offside and aerial interception require separate treatment.
Public StatsBomb displays contain derived aggregates only; raw events stay in the ignored local cache. Data terms are separate from the original code license.
methodology: Source versions and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in data/source_manifest.json. No private club data or paid API access is used.
socceraction converts provider events to SPADL and fits Karun Singh's expected-threat framework on training matches only, retaining failed-move transition mass.
Role-specific metric profiles use explicit exposure shrinkage; a separate 60-bin pass/carry/pressure spatial fingerprint measures where actions occur. Feature weights are visible and adjustable.
Same-player retrieval across train/held-out match windows is a style-stability proxy, not a measure of recruitment success.
SkillCorner tracking and Metrica validation use provider-specific adapters and separate matches. Velocities must be smoothed at native sample rate before control surfaces are computed.

split.scope: Profiles describe train/test union; priors/scales use TRAIN only. Caller verified source match dates.

testPerformance.interpretation: Temporal same-player profile stability proxy; NOT transfer quality or recruitment accuracy.

profileDiagnostics.interpretation: Cosine x 100 is signed profile similarity, NOT quality, probability, or transfer suitability.

skillcorner.coordinates: centered meters; x/y increasing with grid columns/rows

sensitivity.interpretation: Parameter sensitivity only; not accuracy or calibration evidence

metrica.comparisonCaveat: Different anonymized match; not paired validation or accuracy measurement

methodology: Laurie Shaw / Friends of Tracking reference pitch-control implementation; uncalibrated defaults
Offside filtering explicitly disabled; Home is always the first model population
Native 10 Hz velocities: finite differences and centered five-sample smoothing within continuous tracks
Do not differentiate across missing frames, detection transitions, periods, or >12 m/s jumps; unavailable velocity falls back to zero
Broadcast tracking includes extrapolated off-screen positions; detected flags are preserved
16 x 10 cell-center grid in centered pitch meters; rows increase with y, columns with x
A 9.5-second first-phase excerpt is not match-level evidence or a calibrated football forecast
limitations: Separate providers describe different matches and must not be synchronized
Numerical convergence and sensitivity are not accuracy or calibration measurements
Metrica source positions and trajectories are excluded from all returned public objects
